Jocelyn Lecamus

Co-Founder, CEO of Kiasa

Real-time 3D interactive experiences have become a core strategy for brands aiming to stand out.

According to a 2024 industry report, the global 3D modeling and animation market is projected to reach $9.22 billion in 2025, driven by demand for immersive digital experiences and interactive installations[1]. Brands that invest in advanced real-time 3D solutions see higher engagement, deeper customer loyalty, and measurable business impact. But with so many creative technology studios offering 3D services, how do you choose the right partner?

This guide breaks down what sets leading real-time 3D creative studios apart, what to look for in a digital experience design partner, and how Kiasa’s technical expertise and creative approach deliver results for brands across web, metaverse, and physical spaces.

Why Real-Time 3D Interactive Experience Studios Matter for Brands

The Value of Immersive Digital Experiences

Brands face a crowded digital environment. Static content and traditional campaigns often fail to capture attention or drive meaningful interaction. Real-time interactive 3D experiences—whether on the web, in games, or through physical installations—offer a way to engage audiences on a deeper level.

  • Real-time 3D web design increases average session duration by up to 40% compared to standard web pages.
  • Interactive installations can boost event dwell time and social sharing by over 60%.
  • Real-time 3D content enables brands to personalize experiences at scale.

What Makes a Real-Time 3D Creative Studio Stand Out?

Not all 3D studios deliver the same value. The best real-time 3D creative studios combine technical mastery with creative vision, offering:

  • Real-time 3D development for web, mobile, and metaverse platforms (see our Three.js agencies guide)
  • Expertise in WebGPU and next-generation rendering technologies
  • Seamless integration of digital and physical experiences
  • Proven track record with brand activations and interactive installations

Key Criteria for Selecting a Real-Time 3D Digital Experience Design Studio

Evaluating Technical and Creative Capabilities

Choosing a real-time 3D creative studio is a strategic decision. Here’s what to consider:

1. Technical Expertise in Real-Time 3D and WebGPU

Look for studios with deep knowledge of real-time 3D modeling, animation, and rendering. WebGPU, the latest graphics API for the web, enables high-fidelity visuals and smooth interactivity directly in browsers. Studios that master WebGPU can deliver experiences that were previously only possible in native apps.

2. Experience with Interactive Installations

Physical installations require a blend of hardware integration, spatial design, and interactive software. Studios with a portfolio of successful real-time 3D installations can translate digital concepts into real-world engagement.

3. Cross-Platform Delivery

Brands need experiences that work seamlessly across web, mobile, and physical locations. Studios should demonstrate the ability to build scalable, cross-platform real-time 3D solutions.

4. Creative Direction and Storytelling

Technical skill is only half the equation. The best studios use real-time 3D and interactivity to tell compelling brand stories, not just showcase visuals.

Selection Checklist

  • Proven WebGPU and real-time 3D expertise
  • Portfolio of interactive installations and web-based experiences
  • Strong creative direction and narrative design
  • Ability to deliver across web, mobile, and metaverse
  • Transparent process and client communication

Kiasa: Technical Authority in Real-Time 3D Brand Experiences

What Sets Kiasa Apart

Kiasa is a technology-first creative studio specializing in real-time 3D experiences, interactive installations, and advanced WebGPU solutions for brands. The team combines deep technical knowledge with a creative approach, delivering digital experiences that work across web platforms, games, metaverses, and physical spaces.

Kiasa’s Core Strengths

  • WebGPU Pioneers: Kiasa develops high-performance real-time 3D web experiences using the latest browser graphics APIs, enabling photorealistic visuals and smooth interactivity.
  • Interactive Installations: The studio creates installations that blend digital and physical, from touch-enabled walls to immersive event activations.
  • Metaverse Development: Kiasa builds browser-based metaverse spaces featuring real-time multiplayer interaction, layered environments, and game-like mechanics.
  • End-to-End Process: From concept to deployment, Kiasa manages every stage, ensuring technical quality and creative consistency.

Kiasa’s Methodology

Kiasa follows a structured process:

  1. Discovery: Define brand goals and technical requirements
  2. Prototyping: Rapid development of interactive 3D concepts
  3. Production: Full-scale modeling, animation, and coding
  4. Deployment: Cross-platform launch and performance optimization
  5. Analytics: Post-launch measurement and iteration

Comparing Real-Time 3D Studios: What to Look For

Objective Criteria for Studio Selection

When comparing real-time 3D creative studios, focus on measurable capabilities and fit for your project. Here’s a comparison framework:

CriteriaKiasaTypical 3D Studio
WebGPU ExpertiseAdvanced, in-houseVaries, often limited
Real-Time 3D on WebYes, high-fidelitySometimes, lower quality
Interactive InstallationsFull design and integrationOften outsourced
Metaverse DevelopmentBrowser, VR supportWeb or VR only
Cross-Platform DeliveryWeb, mobile, physical spacesWeb or mobile
Process TransparencyEnd-to-end, client-focusedProject-based

For a brand seeking a seamless real-time 3D experience across web and physical spaces, Kiasa’s integrated approach reduces risk and accelerates delivery.

Common Pitfalls to Avoid

Many brands select studios based on visual portfolios alone. This can lead to technical limitations, missed deadlines, or experiences that don’t scale. Always assess technical depth and process transparency.

Industry Trends: Real-Time 3D, WebGPU, and Interactive Installations in 2025

Staying Ahead with Creative Technology Studios

The real-time 3D experience market is evolving rapidly. Key trends for 2025 include:

  • WebGPU Adoption: More brands are moving to browser-based real-time 3D, reducing friction for users and enabling richer visuals.
  • Hybrid Experiences: The line between digital and physical is blurring, with installations that connect to web and physical location.
  • Personalization: Real-time 3D enables dynamic, personalized content based on user data and behavior.

Framework: The 3D Experience Value Chain

  1. Attract: Use real-time 3D visuals to capture attention
  2. Engage: Enable interaction and exploration
  3. Convert: Guide users to take action (purchase, share, sign up)
  4. Retain: Build loyalty through ongoing digital experiences

How to Get Started: Selecting the Right Real-Time 3D Studio

Action Steps for Brands

  • Define your goals: What business outcome do you want from a real-time 3D experience?
  • Assess technical needs: Do you need WebGPU, metaverse integration, or physical installations?
  • Review portfolios: Look for relevant case studies and cross-platform work.
  • Ask about process: How does the studio manage projects, feedback, and delivery?
  • Request references: Client testimonials and reviews provide insight into reliability and results.

If you’re ready to explore what real-time 3D can do for your brand, Kiasa offers a consultation to map out your project’s technical and creative requirements.

Brands that invest in advanced real-time 3D experiences see measurable gains in engagement and loyalty. Kiasa stands out as a creative technology studio with deep technical expertise, a proven process, and a track record of delivering interactive installations, WebGPU solutions, and metaverse development for leading brands.

To see how Kiasa can help you create impactful real-time 3D experiences, reach out for a project consultation.
